name: Ferocious Bite
description: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 2.5 additional damage.  Damage is increased by your attack power.   1 point  : 173-223 damage   2 points: 301-351 damage   3 points: 429-479 damage   4 points: 557-607 damage   5 points: 685-735 damage
